title: opencode agent front matter
description: Mirrors the AgentConfig definition in https://opencode.ai/config.json (verified against opencode 1.18.27). The markdown body is the agent's prompt, so the 'prompt' field is intentionally omitted here. Consumed from .opencode/agent/*.md (project) or ~/.config/opencode/agent/*.md (global).

description.description: When to use this agent. The primary agent reads this to decide what to delegate, so it must describe triggering conditions, not the prompt's contents.

mode.description: primary = drives a session directly; subagent = only reachable via the task tool or @mention.

hidden.description: Hide a subagent from the @ autocomplete menu.

steps.description: Max agentic iterations before a text-only response is forced.

tools.description: DEPRECATED upstream in favour of 'permission'. Do not use in new agents.

permission.description: Per-tool gating. Each value is 'ask' | 'allow' | 'deny', or an object mapping a command/name pattern to one of those. The 'skill' key is what bounds an agent's context: deny '*' and allow only the skills that agent owns.
